0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (0-1, 5th in the Pacific and 1.5 games back, 15th in the West) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West), who have won both of their games so far, going 1-0 at home and 1-0 on the road. The Suns lost 2-3 to Oklahoma City in the 2025-26 season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and their most recent meeting came in those playoffs on April 27 in Phoenix, a 131-122 Suns loss. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain), while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery).
